title: Джейсон Шрайер раскрыл подробности отменённого проекта Bungie - песочницы во вселенной Destiny под названием Payback
contents: Согласно отчёту Bloomberg, Bungie в течение некоторого времени работала над игрой-песочницей во вселенной Destiny. Проект, возглавляемый Люком Смитом и Марком Ноузворти, получил название Payback. По описанию Шрайера, это должен был быть «будущий» Destiny — с той же вселенной, но, возможно, без привычного названия франшизы. Структура игры значительно отличалась от того, к чему привыкли фанаты Destiny. Шрайер сравнил Payback с Genshin Impact: акцент на героях, открытый мир, исследование и решение ...

title: В Destiny 2 вернется вырезанный контент, но Bungie не планирует возвращаться к регулярным обновлениям
contents: Bungie собирается вернуть в Destiny 2 значительный объём ранее отключённого контента, однако это не означает полноценного возвращения игры к прежней модели поддержки. Согласно отчёту Forbes, команда не планирует возобновлять регулярный выпуск крупных обновлений и нового контента. Речь идёт о кампаниях, рейдах и миссиях, которые ранее были удалены в рамках системы vaulting. После запланированного возвращения они станут бесплатно доступны всем игрокам, в том числе тем, кто не владел ими до отключе...

title: Bungie decide their destiny is to do more Destiny after all, pledging to bring back vaulted Destiny 2 campaigns while declaring that Marathon "needs to evolve"
contents: Not long after announcing changes to how they'll handle majorly updating Marathon going forwards, Bungie have reversed course on their decision to stop developing Destiny 2 - a move they followed with layoffs. Promising to bring back vaulted bits of Destiny 2 and declaring that the series is "foundational" to their future. A future which they've kicked off with a lot of grovelling for forgiveness. Read more

title: Bungie unvaulting Destiny 2 content was a studio-saving emergency decision, because Marathon updates were never going to be enough
author: Samuel Roberts
contents: Over the past couple of months, my Destiny 2 Fireteam has given me a tour of the Destiny 2 content I missed when I hopped off the train following the pandemic. When you play all the dungeons back-to-back, it's a buffet of delights—a concentrated dose of amazing and frequently obtuse FPS level design that you simply can't find anywhere else. A reminder that Bungie, pre-layoffs, was the very best at what it did... Read more.

title: Официально: Bungie возобновит поддержку Destiny 2 и вернёт весь удалённый контент
author: Вадим Съедин
contents: Bungie объявила о решении возобновить поддержку Destiny 2. Как пояснил новый лидер студии Порья Торкан, за последние несколько лет Bungie лишилась доверия со стороны аудитории и потеряла ценных специалистов. Сейчас она намерена трансформироваться.

title: Bungie un-cancels Destiny: Vaulted content is coming back as new leadership promises 'Destiny is foundational to our future'
author: Morgan Park
contents: Bungie's new leadership duo laid out the "next chapter of Bungie" today in a blog post with an accompanying video. The big news is that Bungie has essentially uncanceled Destiny 2, or will at least go the lengths to finally undo its greatest mistake: vaulting a bunch of raids and multiple of its story campaigns. Funnily enough, that work has already begun on the community side with a mod project that makes vaulted content playable through an offline build of Destiny... Read more.

title: Destiny возвращается после отмены поддержки благодаря фанатам - Bungie вернёт вырезанный контент и готовит новые игры
contents: Bungie неожиданно пересмотрела планы по развитию Destiny 2. Всего через несколько месяцев после заявления о прекращении выпуска нового контента студия объявила о возвращении ранее удалённых материалов и подтвердила, что у вселенной Destiny есть будущее за пределами текущей игры. Главной частью заявления стало возвращение контента, который начал исчезать из Destiny 2 ещё в 2020 году. Bungie планирует вернуть кампании и локации Red War и Forsaken, а также более ранние дополнения Curse of Osiris и ...

title: Bungie готова сдать в аренду свою штаб-квартиру на срок до 2035 года
author: Вадим Съедин
contents: В 2021 году американское руководство Bungie объявило о масштабном расширении (почти в три раза) штаб-квартиры студии в штате Вашингтон. По данным СМИ, на кампус площадью 1,9 гектара было потрачено несколько сотен миллионов долларов.

title: Джейсон Шрайер: За последние годы Bungie отменила несколько сервисов — они должны были принести Sony большие деньги
author: Семен Страндов
contents: До присоединения к Sony студия Bungie одновременно занималась приблизительно пятью-шестью проектами, включая поддержку Destiny 2, разработку Marathon и создание нескольких других сервисов. Об этом рассказал журналист Bloomberg Джейсон Шрайер в новом видео.

title: Destiny 2 players are learning how to crack into its infamous content vault by tinkering with old game builds
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: In June 2020, Bungie made what would come to be remembered as one of the most reviled PR incidents in modern videogames: It announced the content vault. To make Destiny 2's long-term development more manageable, the studio said, the launch of its Beyond Light expansion coincided with a culling of in-game content, paring away story campaigns, world regions, and activities of all stripes... Read more.

title: Discussion time: Have you ever said goodbye to an MMO you've played for 1,000s of hours?
author: Sean Martin
contents: s someone who writes guides for a living, I'm always hopping between different games, riding the ever-rolling wave of live service updates, DLC, and new releases that define our industry. I've dipped my toes into all sorts of MMOs over the years, but amidst the constant barrage of games, only one ended up sticking around for me, and that was Destiny 2... Read more.

title: Warframe creative director says Destiny 2's end is tragic, because even with hard work 'the business side of this industry always gets the last remark'
author: Harvey Randall
contents: Destiny 2 isn't going anywhere, but it also isn't… well, going anywhere. The game's servers will still be running for the foreseeable future, but Bungie has since ceased updates to its flagship shooter to move onto other projects, tragically laying off much of its staff in the aftermath of that decision... Read more.

title: Destiny 2 players get a final farewell gift from Bungie
author: Andy Chalk
contents: Destiny 2 is done: The final patch is out, Bungie is decimated, and the game will remain playable but the story of one of the biggest, best and most influential online shooters ever is over. To memorialize the moment, Bungie has rolled out one last gift for players: A new emblem, free for everyone, called Gloriabundus... Read more.

title: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director settles $200 million lawsuit against Sony and Bungie: 'The outcome is one I am very satisfied with'
author: Andy Chalk
contents: Former Destiny 2 and Marathon director Christopher Barrett has settled his lawsuit against Sony and Bungie. Terms of the settlement were not disclosed, but Barrett implied a favorable outcome, saying he's "very satisfied" with it... Read more.

title: Players prove Destiny 2 can still produce wonders with discovery of poopy pants transmog
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: Destiny 2 has entered its long goodnight. Despite earlier assurances that Destiny 2 will "remain playable" for the foreseeable future, the studio now seems to be signaling that its ability to ensure the game's ongoing health is constrained. Even if Bungie and Sony had the will to ensure Destiny 2's sandbox stays fulfilling in its sunset years, they'd struggle to find someone to make it happen—because most of the Destiny team was cut loose last month... Read more.

title: You're invited to Destiny's cursed unofficial final raid: Pete Carsons' Vault of Cars
author: Rory Norris
contents: The reasons behind the decline and ultimate end of Destiny 2 will always be a topic of discussion. It's, in my opinion, one of the biggest fumbles in entertainment history. No one thing is to blame, but former Bungie CEO and avid car collector Pete Parsons, who retired in August 2025 as sentiment was at an all-time low and pressure from Sony grew, is the focus of much of the ire. "I hope all your cars break down," one player wrote in a cheerful farewell to the departing CEO last year, in a rare ...

title: Amid mass layoffs at Bungie, the official White House X account issues sociopathic Destiny 2 meme
author: Shaun Prescott
contents: In its latest videogame-themed, AI-generated meme, the official White House X account has published a Destiny 2 character sheet featuring an unrealistically ripped Donald Trump wielding a Gjallarhorn... Read more.

title: Following the last Destiny 2 update, layoffs at Bungie are underway, with most of the shooter's team affected
contents: Back in May, Bungie announced that their long running shooter MMO Destiny 2 would be getting its final ever big update in June. At the time there were rumours that layoffs would follow not long after the update arrived. Now, a little over two weeks since the update dropped, Bungie have confirmed that layoffs are taking place. Read more

title: With Destiny 2 over, Bungie lays off 'most of the Destiny team and some Marathon team members'
author: Andy Chalk
contents: Bungie has announced a "reduction in force" as it reorganizes following the end of development on Destiny 2, saying that with its premiere game now ended and new projects still in very early stages of development, "we unfortunately could not continue operating at our previous size.".. Read more.

title: 'Don't blame yourselves' for Destiny 2's end, community lead tells players: 'No words can accurately depict how lucky we are to have shared these worlds with you'
author: Andy Chalk
contents: Destiny 2 has reached the end of the line: The final update is live, TWIDs are over, and we're all left wondering how the one-time king of live service shooters has come to such ignominious ruin. Even Destiny's competitors are baffled by Sony's decision to pull the plug, although some say Sony's not the real villain here at all. If there is a villain, besides Bungie management—which I think we can all agree has been pretty consistently not great—one thing's for sure: It's not Destiny players... ...

title: "Truthfully, it's heartbreaking": Warframe dev on the hole that Destiny 2 leaves behind
contents: There's long been a bit of a rivalry between Destiny and Warframe's respective communities because of them both being shooty, sci-fi, MMOy joints. But when it comes to the community director behind Warframe, the recent end to new Destiny 2 updates and expansions is no victory, and mostly just finds the whole situation to be "devastating." Read more

title: We could've had a 'very Dream Daddy-inspired' Destiny dating sim, but management said no fun
author: Rory Norris
contents: If you were thinking Destiny 2's ending couldn't get any more depressing, you're wrong. Unfortunately. In a reaction to my pondering of what Destiny 3 should even be (if ever made, of course), a streamer by the name of Chrizmo demanded something that's been brought up a few times over the years: a dating sim... Read more.

title: Bungie's at a crossroads: Should Destiny 3 be a live service, just a campaign, or something else entirely?
author: Rory Norris
contents: Now that Destiny 2's massive final update is here, it's more or less set in stone forever. Destiny is calcified—no more FOMO, no need to re-grind gear, and the end of a seasonal treadmill... Read more.

title: Ситуацию с закрытием Destiny 2 объяснили
author: Илья
contents: Обозреватель Forbes Пол Тасси связался с источниками внутри Bungie, чтобы уточнить обстоятельства прекращения активной поддержки Destiny 2.

title: Несмотря на тёплый приём финального обновления Destiny 2, Sony не одобрила новые проекты Bungie — студию ждут увольнения
author: Илья
contents: Вышедшее 9 июня финальное обновление Destiny 2 было тепло встречено сообществом. Интерес к нему оказался настолько высоким, что в первые часы после релиза пользователи сообщали о проблемах с доступом к серверам, а пиковый онлайн в Steam знаительно превысил показатели Marathon. Кроме того, за прошедшую неделю Destiny 2 вошла в тройку самых прибыльных игр платформы Steam.

title: BFM TV: Sony уволит 50% сотрудников Bungie до конца лета
author: Вадим Съедин
contents: Руководство японской компании Sony планирует сократить около 50% сотрудников американской студии Bungie в рамках следующей волны реструктуризации. Об этом сообщил редактор французского телеканала BFM TV Сильвен Тринель со ссылкой на собственные источники.

title: Bungie will let Destiny 2 'near infinite damage' bug ride for a week: 'Do your thing'
author: Tyler Wilde
contents: Destiny 2's final content update threw so much into the shooter that something was bound to break, and break it did. An upcoming patch will fix a "near infinite damage" bug introduced by the Monument of Triumph update, but the developers at Bungie have decided to drag their feet on the fix to let more players have a taste of godlike power... Read more.

title: An obscure new game-breaking Destiny bug lets you one-hit bosses, and I don't think Bungie's gonna let this one slide (Update: Bungie is letting it slide... for a little bit)
author: Rory Norris
contents: Destiny 2's live service ambitions have come to an end with its final update last week. And with it, Bungie added everything and the kitchen sink, from new catalysts for every Exotic weapon to broken perk combinations. With no new endgame to grind or necessarily protect the sanctity of balance, Bungie's set us free with some of the most broken—and fun—tools we've ever had... Read more.

title: Destiny 2 comes full circle as players honour the tradition of pushing bosses to their deaths—this time by becoming a porcupine and smacking them with a void football
author: Harvey Randall
contents: Destiny 2's sun is setting, and it's perhaps fitting that one of the oldest traditions of the franchise—that is, pushing bosses to their doom—is happening once again. Except this time, they're becoming porcupines holding void light footballs which smacks bosses so hard they fall to their deaths... Read more.

title: It's bittersweet that the best time to play Destiny 2 in years coincides with its end, but I'm happy for the new players who get to experience its most liberating iteration yet
author: Sean Martin
contents: When Bungie announced the final update for Destiny 2, I felt relieved. It surprised me as well. As someone who's spent the past six years (and over 3,000 hours) battling humanity's enemies across the solar system, you'd think that news of my favorite MMO's end would fill me with sadness. But no, just a bittersweet sense of relief as I considered we were finally moving on (as we should've after The Final Shape's year) to whatever the future may hold... Read more.

title: Former Destiny 2 CM claims Bungie was 'very close to shutting its doors' before the buyout
author: Rory Norris
contents: It's a bittersweet time for any Destiny fan, as Destiny 2 is now in stasis after its final update. Hell, even This Week In Destiny, my weekly ritual for over a decade now, is coming to an end. All good things must finish, I guess... Read more.

title: I'm sad, I'm angry, I'm interested: Destiny's final cutscenes are a painful end to a new saga cut short
author: Rory Norris
contents: Destiny 2's Monuments of Triumph is here, the final update for the game and potentially the last Destiny anything. Even This Week In Destiny, my weekly ritual for over a decade now, is coming to an end. To that end, Bungie has crammed in as much of a conclusion as possible, given we're actually at the start of a brand-new saga... Read more.

title: Time to get a little sadder about Destiny 2: TWIDs are coming to an end
author: Andy Chalk
contents: Destiny 2 is ending—for all intents and purposes, in fact, it already has, with the launch earlier this week of its final update, Monument of Triumph. More than one Destiny fan at PC Gamer has described the moment as bittersweet—it's not only Destiny 2's last live service update, it's also one of its best—and in a smaller way, this is too: Maybe it's no surprise, but the clockwork-like This Week in Destiny updates will soon be over... Read more.

title: This Week In Destiny - 06/11/2026
author: Destiny2_Team
contents: This week in Destiny, we launched Monument of Triumph, our last live service update for the best game ever made, aka Destiny 2. We hope you had fun and that you could reunite with old friends, whether they are old raid bosses that have been away for far too long or weapons reprised with all the love in the world. There were new friends coming to the party, too. Don't you love surprises?Destiny 2: The Collection TrailerThe Pantheon Grows...Trials of Osiris Returns June 12New Player Guide Updated ...

title: All 26 new catalysts in Destiny 2's final update
author: Rory Norris
contents: Strange as it is, Destiny 2's massive final update is here, marking the end of an era. But Bungie's gone out with a bang here, not least because it's added 26 new catalysts and updated nine old ones. No Exotic weapons have been left behind, and that's a fitting way to leave things... Read more.

title: How to complete the Distortions quest in Destiny 2
author: Sean Martin
contents: The new Distortions quest in Destiny 2 introduces you to the event of the same name, which Bungie hopes will revitalise destination-based play a little more now that the game has received its final update. There is a range of really good new weapons available in this event, so it's well worth the time if you find something you want to farm, especially with the inclusion of attunement for pretty much all activities... Read more.

title: How to score a goal in the hidden net in Destiny 2
author: Rory Norris
contents: Destiny 2's Monuments of Triumph final update is here, giving you tons of challenges to complete, new catalysts to collect, and even a new Exotic mission for the Cull's Shadow. One such challenge is the very enthusiastically named GOOOAAAALLL!!!, which requires you to kick a ball into the hidden net... Read more.

title: Bungie анонсировала «Destiny 2: Коллекция» и выпустила «Destiny 2: Коллекция «Классика» в PlayStation Plus
author: Rakot
contents: Минувшим вечером игрокам Destiny 2 стало доступно обновление «Монумент триумфа». Финальная порция контента привлекла более 160 тысяч поклонников серии в Steam. Разработчики оказались не готовы к такому, из-за чего серверы в очередной раз рухнули .

author: Tyler Wilde
contents: It's the day of Destiny 2's final live service update, and players have swarmed into the shooter to celebrate the game and make their demands for Destiny 3 known... Read more.

author: Destiny2_Team
contents: Destiny 2: The Collection includes all available expansions and content packs in addition to four reward passes as well as access to endgame pursuits such as Raids, Dungeons, and more.

title: Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph Update
author: Destiny2_Team
contents: The Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph Update is available to all players. A new set of Triumphs guides you across Destiny 2 activities, turning familiar moments into a personal journey with new rewards to earn. Pantheon returns with rotating raid bosses and modifiers, Sparrow Racing League makes its D2 debut with classic tracks and new maps, Distortions send you back to key destinations, Heavy Metal adds the Cabal Behemoth and vehicle mayhem, and a unified Director brings activities into one place....

author: Phil Savage
contents: fter nine years, eight expansions and a mountain of updates—many good, plenty questionable—Destiny 2's final ever patch releases today. The Monument of Triumph is the final hoorah; the last big release before the studio walks away from the game forever... Read more.

contents: fter nine years, eight expansions and a mountain of updates—many good, plenty questionable—Destiny 2's final ever patch releases today. The Monument of Triumph is the final hoorah; the last big release before the studio walks away from the game forever... Read more.

title: 'There is no world where it makes sense,' Warframe creative director says of Destiny 2's demise: 'It's unthinkable'
author: Andy Chalk
contents: The end of Destiny 2 development came as a surprise to everyone: players, streamers, casual observers, and even the development team at Bungie, most of whom reportedly had no idea it was happening until it happened. It was such an outrageous move that even Rebb Ford, the creative director of Warframe—the other Destiny—called it "unthinkable.".. Read more.

title: Monument of Triumph Trailer

title: 'What was unravelling is suddenly stabilizing': Destiny 2's last update is getting an absurd 71 pages of patch notes, but its story is closing with a shrug
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: I don't know what to say anymore, man. In the two weeks since announcing that Destiny 2 will soon be entering maintenance mode, Bungie has been gradually unveiling a massive slate of changes for its final Monument of Triumph update. Those additions and quality-of-life reworks have been so well-received that D2's daily peak player counts are now almost triple what they were immediately before its retirement date was declared... title: Destiny fans cry 'We Want Destiny 3' into void, void does not respond
author: Tyler Wilde
contents: ccording to Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier, Bungie hasn't greenlit any game for the Destiny 2 team to pivot to after content updates for the long-running shooter end, never mind Destiny 3. The studio is reportedly hearing pitches for new projects, which may or may not take place in the Destiny universe... Read more.

title: It's wild that Destiny 2's biggest ever quality-of-life update is the one that ends the game
author: Phil Savage
contents: Next week, Destiny 2 comes to an end . The Monument of Triumph update, releasing on June 9, marks the final release for Bungie's nine-year-old live-service behemoth. I have to admit that, when I first heard the news, I was almost relieved—over the last year I've watched the game's baffling new direction alienate almost every person I regularly played with. Thanks to the disastrous introduction of the Portal and the unravelling of the many player concessions made under the Joe Blackburn era, D...

title: Steam reviewer says 'I am done with this game' after 10,000 hours of Destiny 2, then plays another 160 hours just to be sure
author: Ted Litchfield
contents: "Guy who leaves negative Steam review after ungodly hour count" is truly one of the strongest soldiers in modern gaming. They scare me. It's a practice that speaks of obsession, but also a level of expertise and familiarity you just can't fake: What do you say to someone who knows your game that well, and hates it? Anyway, I'm in awe of ArkaneArdvark78, who left a negative Steam review of Destiny 2 after 10,098.5 hours, then kept playing for another 157.8 hours... Read more.

title: Bungie devs have resurrected an obscene amount of guns for Destiny 2's final update: 'My body physically hurts from the amount of items we were updating'
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: Its entry into retirement is approaching, but Destiny 2 is being sent out with a bang. After detailing the ways D2 activities are evolving in its end-of-new-content Monument of Triumph update, Bungie today has provided more specifics about the avalanche of new and returning weaponry it's spilling into its various loot pools... title: This Week In Destiny - 05/29/2026
author: Destiny2_Team

Except the choice didn't come last week, but earlier in the year, a choice that another repor...

title: Former Bungie dev says 'you'd be surprised how many times' expansions were pitched for a fan-favorite Destiny archvillain who's now left hanging
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: The announcement of Destiny 2's imminent end of live service development wasn't entirely unexpected news, given Bungie's well-documented struggles in recent years, but it's an abrupt conclusion for a game series that's now left with an uncertain future. Reportedly, Bungie hasn't yet greenlit a project for a Destiny 3, meaning many of the setting's ongoing narrative threads are being left without resolution for the foreseeable future... Read more.

title: Destiny developers reflect on the end of an era: 'We all worked so hard to maintain the quality bar under unrealistic constraints'
author: Rory Norris
contents: Yesterday, Bungie announced that Destiny 2 is officially over, with its final live service update arriving on June 9. After 10 expansions, 30 seasons, three episodes, and spanning almost a decade, it's not an understatement to say that it's the end of an era. The salt in the wound is a report that Bungie isn't immediately making Destiny 3 and is eyeing potential layoffs... Read more.

title: Bungie isn't immediately making Destiny 3, is planning layoffs, reports Bloomberg

contents: Today's not-entirely-unexpected announcement that Destiny 2 will no longer receive "live service content updates" has some fans hoping that Bungie is performing a controlled demolition to make way for Destiny 3... Read more.

title: Destiny 2 hasn't been the game I'd loved in years, but it still sucks to know it's ending
author: Lincoln Carpenter
contents: Today, after 10 expansions, three episodes, 30 seasons, and almost nine years, Bungie announced that Destiny 2's live service development is coming to an end on June 9, 2026. It isn't surprising news: To the culture at large, Destiny 2 has become less of a game in earnest and more of a measuring stick for its beleaguered studio's dysfunction following years of blatant mismanagement, and Bungie's prolonged silence as player numbers continued to dwindle had become deafening... Read more.

title: Destiny 2: Every End is a New Beginning
author: Destiny2_Team
contents: For almost twelve years, we have had the joy and honor to explore the Destiny universe with you all. Through all the ups and downs, surprises and triumphs, building Destiny alongside our players has been a monumental privilege. While our love for Destiny 2 has not changed, it has become clear that after The Final Shape, we have reached the time for our shared worlds, and Destiny, to live beyond Destiny 2. As our focus turns towards a new beginning for Bungie, we will begin work incubating our ne...
